edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the from address of transfer().
msg.sender is used as spender when decrementing allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as fromAddress.
_msgSender() result is compared with owner() inside onlyOwner.
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable through owner().
burnToken is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdrawOperationFund is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setminHoldingThreshold is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setMaxTxnAmount is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBatchSize is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
startGoApe is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
payoutLargeRedistribution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
payoutMediumRedistribution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
payoutSmallRedistribution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
EndGoApe is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
block.timestamp is hashed with msg.sender to pick the large prize winner.
block.timestamp is hashed with msg.sender to pick medium prize recipients.
block.timestamp is stored as Entity._createdAt when adding an entity.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
_transfer invokes swapAndLiquify, which performs external calls before balances are finalized.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth which makes an external router call.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity which sends ETH externally.
swapTokensForEth reaches the uniswap swap external call with tokenAmount.
addLiquidity reaches the addLiquidityETH external call with token and ETH amounts.
The router swap can call back into the contract before swapAndLiquify completes.
The liquidity call can re-enter the contract during swapAndLiquify execution.
ETH returned by the swap is received through the payable receive() hook.
swapAndLiquify is wrapped by the lockTheSwap reentrancy guard.
lockTheSwap toggles the inSwapAndLiquify guard flag.
_transfer calls _getValues to compute the taxed amount.
_transfer updates _balance for sender and recipient.
_transfer adds recipients above the holding threshold as entities.
_transfer removes senders below the holding threshold.
_transfer shuffles entities on every transfer.
_transfer calls getCommunityFund to derive the free contract balance.
_transfer compares balances against minHoldingThreshold.
_transfer enforces the maxTxAmount limit.
_getValues calls _extractapeFund.
_getValues calls _extractOperationalFund.
_getValues calls _extractBurnableFund.
_extractapeFund increases the apeFund state variable.
_extractOperationalFund increases the operationalFund state variable.
_extractBurnableFund increases the burnableFund state variable.
Ape tax amount is computed via _getExtractableFund arithmetic.
Operational tax amount is computed via _getExtractableFund arithmetic.
Burnable tax amount is computed via _getExtractableFund arithmetic.
mul/div on user-controlled amount and rate feeds balance updates.
Balance subtraction and post-transfer accounting occur after the external swap call.
burnToken subtracts amount from contract balance, _total and burnableFund.
rewardAmount is computed as bananaPrizeTotal divided by lastEntryAllowed.
Winner index is derived from predictable timestamp-based randomness.
Recipient indices are derived from predictable timestamp-based randomness.
payoutLargeRedistribution reads the candidate entity via getEntity.
Large prize payout reads entity data from indexToEntity.
Medium prize payout iterates and mutates indexToEntity entries.
Small prize payout iterates indexToEntity by index.
startGoApe sets junglePrizeTotal from apeFund.
startGoApe sets apePrizeTotal from apeFund.
startGoApe sets bananaPrizeTotal as the remainder.
startGoApe freezes lastEntryAllowed to the current lastIndexUsed.
Large prize payout decrements apeFund.
Large prize payout credits the winner and debits the contract balance.
Medium prize payout decrements apeFund by the disbursed total.
Medium prize payout credits each eligible holder address.
Small prize payout credits rewardAmount to each valid entity.
Small prize payout decrements apeFund by the disbursed total.
EndGoApe clears lastEntryAllowed.
EndGoApe zeroes junglePrizeTotal.
EndGoApe zeroes apePrizeTotal.
EndGoApe zeroes bananaPrizeTotal.
withdrawOperationFund reduces operationalFund.
withdrawOperationFund moves balances from the contract to walletAddress.
burnToken reduces burnableFund.
burnToken reduces _total supply.
Constructor assigns the whole supply to the deployer balance.
Constructor fixes _total as the initial supply.
Constructor stores the Uniswap router instance.
Constructor creates and stores the Uniswap pair address.
Constructor registers the deployer as the first entity.
addEntity increments lastIndexUsed.
removeEntity decrements lastIndexUsed with subtraction arithmetic.
shuffleEntities uses modulo over lastIndexUsed - 1 to pick slots.
transferOwnership reassigns the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom updates allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the allowance via _approve.
_approve stores the allowance in the _allowances mapping.
getCommunityFund sums apeFund.
getCommunityFund sums burnableFund.
getCommunityFund sums operationalFund.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer by transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer by transferFrom.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer by transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer and allowance subtraction.
newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner.
walletAddress parameter receives the withdrawn operational funds.
randNum local is used as the entity index for the large prize.
seed local is mixed into the randomness hash for the large prize.
seed local is incremented and hashed in the medium prize loop.
counter local bounds the eligible recipient loop.
startIndex parameter sets the payout loop start.

normalization_plan.reason: param_recipient is a non-core parameter only meaningful as the destination argument of transfer/transferFrom, so merge it into transfer.
param_amount is a non-core parameter consumed by transfer and the tax/balance arithmetic, so merge it into transfer.
param_newOwner is a non-core parameter used only by transferOwnership, so merge it into that function.
param_walletAddress is a non-core parameter used only by withdrawOperationFund, so merge it into that function.
local_randNum is a non-core local derived from timestamp randomness inside payoutLargeRedistribution, so merge it into that function.
local_seed is a non-core local seeded and hashed in the prize payout functions, so merge it into payoutLargeRedistribution.
local_counter is a non-core loop local of payoutMediumRedistribution, so merge it into that function.
param_startIndex is a non-core parameter used only by payoutSmallRedistribution, so merge it into that function.
